# nanochat

> The simplest experimental harness for training LLMs — train GPT-2 capability for ~$72

nanochat is a minimal, full-stack ChatGPT clone by Andrej Karpathy covering tokenization, pretraining, SFT, RL, evaluation, inference, and a chat UI. A single --depth parameter auto-configures all hyperparameters for compute-optimal training.

## Getting Started

- [Overview](getting-started/overview.md): What is nanochat and why it exists
- [Installation](getting-started/installation.md): Environment setup, hardware requirements
- [GPT-2 Speedrun](getting-started/speedrun-walkthrough.md): Complete pipeline walkthrough
- [Quick Reference](getting-started/quick-reference.md): Commands and troubleshooting

## Architecture

- [GPT Model](deep-dive/architecture/gpt-model.md): Transformer with RoPE, QK norm, ReLU², GQA
- [Attention](deep-dive/architecture/attention-mechanisms.md): Flash Attention 3, SDPA fallback
- [MLP & Blocks](deep-dive/architecture/mlp-and-blocks.md): Residual connections, per-layer scalars
- [Scaling](deep-dive/architecture/scaling-and-configuration.md): Depth dial, auto-configuration

## Data Pipeline

- [Tokenizer](deep-dive/data-pipeline/tokenizer.md): BPE with RustBPE + tiktoken
- [Dataset](deep-dive/data-pipeline/dataset.md): FineWeb-Edu 100BT
- [Dataloader](deep-dive/data-pipeline/dataloader.md): BOS-aligned bestfit packing
